exercises.title: 7. Passe para o Past Simple. (Fill in)

items.prompt: I write the report. → Yesterday, I ___ the report.
items.hintAfterError: Verbo irregular: o passado não termina em -ed.

items.prompt: We send invoices on Fridays. → Last Friday, we ___ five invoices.
items.hintAfterError: Verbo irregular: troca o -d final por -t.

items.prompt: Ethan calls the client every day. → Yesterday, he ___ the client.
Sophie meets the team every Monday. → Last Monday, she ___ the team.
The ship arrives today. → The ship ___ yesterday.
We check the market every morning. → This morning, we ___ the market.
I sign contracts on Mondays. → On Monday, I ___ two contracts.
They send payments weekly. → Last week, they ___ the payment.
I write emails every hour. → Today, I ___ ten emails.
She calls the supplier daily. → Yesterday, she ___ the supplier.
